name: openpose
description: OpenPose: Real-time multi-person keypoint detection library for body, face, hands, and foot estimation
readme_summary: OpenPose is a real-time C++ library for multi-person keypoint detection, capable of estimating the pose of bodies, faces, hands, and feet from single images. It provides a comprehensive solution for human pose estimation and understanding in various applications.
key_features: Detection of body, face, hand, and foot keypoints
C++ library with Caffe and OpenCV dependencies
primary_use_case: Real-time human pose estimation for multiple individuals in images and videos, enabling applications in human behavior understanding, motion analysis, and interactive systems.
cover_image_prompt: A digital artist standing in a vibrant, futuristic studio, holding a magical brush. With swift strokes, the artist paints glowing outlines of human figures onto a large canvas. Each figure is precisely outlined with key points highlighting their body, face, hands, and feet. Around the artist, small holographic screens display live video feeds of people, with their poses being instantly mapped. Subtle code snippets and data streams flow like digital paint. The overall mood is creative and technologically advanced, with a clean, focused composition. The style should be a 3D isometric illustration with bright, contrasting colors and a sense of dynamic motion.

name: ux-ui-agent-skills
description: Turn Claude into a Senior Design Architect — DTCG design tokens, 42 components, WCAG 2.2 accessibility, any-framework code, 138 design systems, and runnable skills.
readme_summary: This repository transforms AI models like Claude into expert UX/UI design architects. It provides a comprehensive kit of instructions, design tokens, and runnable skills to generate consistent, accessible, and production-ready UI components for any framework and design system.
primary_use_case: To empower AI agents with the knowledge and tools to act as senior UX/UI design architects, enabling them to generate high-quality, accessible, and framework-agnostic UI components and design system assets.
cover_image_prompt: A master architect, depicted as a wise owl with blueprints unfurled, standing in a digital workshop. The owl is orchestrating a symphony of glowing design elements – colors, typography, spacing – that flow from its wings like a digital stream. These elements are being seamlessly assembled into diverse UI components (buttons, cards, forms) that materialize on floating screens representing different frameworks (React, SwiftUI, Vue). Subtle lines of code and WCAG accessibility icons are woven into the scene. The overall mood is one of intelligent creation and organized design. Style: 3D isometric illustration with a clean, modern aesthetic and a vibrant, organized color palette.

name: optimizerDuck
description: Free, open-source Windows optimization tool for performance, privacy, and simplicity.
readme_summary: optimizerDuck is a free, open-source Windows optimization tool designed to enhance system performance, bolster privacy, and simplify user experience. It offers a range of tweaks and debloating options for Windows 10 and above.
primary_use_case: Optimizing Windows operating systems for better performance and privacy.
cover_image_prompt: A friendly, stylized duck character, embodying 'optimizerDuck', is meticulously organizing and polishing a cluttered, old-fashioned computer. The duck is using a glowing, digital wrench to tighten loose wires and a spray bottle emitting a clean, digital mist to remove 'bloatware' icons. Input is represented by a messy pile of digital junk and error messages, while the output is a sleek, modern, and fast-looking computer with a clear, organized interface. The scene is set in a clean, bright workshop with subtle UI elements and code snippets floating around. The style should be a vibrant 3D isometric illustration with a focus on clarity and a playful, helpful mood.

name: nerd-fonts
description: Iconic font aggregator, collection, & patcher. 3,600+ icons, 50+ patched fonts: Hack, Source Code Pro, more. Glyph collections: Font Awesome, Material Design Icons, Octicons, & more
readme_summary: Nerd Fonts is a project that enhances programming fonts by patching them with a vast collection of glyphs and icons from popular icon sets. It provides an easy way to install these enhanced fonts or to patch your own fonts, making your terminal and code editor visually richer.
key_features: Patches popular programming fonts with thousands of extra glyphs from icon sets like Font Awesome, Material Design Icons, Octicons, and more.
Offers a wide variety of installation options for different operating systems (macOS, Windows, Linux).
Includes a font patcher tool for users to patch their own desired fonts.
Provides pre-patched fonts in various formats and download options.
Supports integration with tools like Powerline and statuslines for enhanced terminal aesthetics.
primary_use_case: To enhance the visual appearance of code editors and terminals by adding a comprehensive set of icons and glyphs to programming fonts, improving readability and aesthetics.
cover_image_prompt: A whimsical, magical workshop where a friendly artisan is carefully placing tiny, glowing icons (like stars, gears, code brackets, and speech bubbles) into the letters of a plain, black and white font. The icons are flowing from a large, open book labeled 'Iconic Fonts' and a digital stream of code. The artisan is using a glowing tool to fuse the icons seamlessly into the font. The background shows a stylized, clean terminal interface with colorful icons integrated into the text. The overall mood is creative and helpful, with a warm, inviting light. The art style should be a vibrant 3D isometric illustration with clear, friendly characters and a focus on the transformation of the font.

name: mobile-mcp
description: Model Context Protocol Server for Mobile Automation and Scraping (iOS, Android, Emulators, Simulators and Real Devices)
readme_summary: Mobile MCP is a TypeScript-based server that acts as a platform-agnostic interface for automating iOS and Android mobile applications. It allows AI agents and LLMs to interact with native apps on emulators, simulators, and real devices using accessibility data or screenshot-based interactions.
key_features: Supports iOS and Android (simulators, emulators, real devices)
Full device control (taps, swipes, app management, etc.)
Structured and deterministic UI element extraction
Compatibility with AI clients like Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, Copilot
primary_use_case: Enabling AI agents and LLMs to automate native iOS and Android mobile applications through a unified, platform-independent interface.
cover_image_prompt: A skilled conductor standing on a podium, orchestrating a symphony of diverse mobile devices (iPhones, Android phones, tablets) that are all seamlessly playing in unison. Instead of a baton, the conductor wields a glowing digital wand that emits streams of structured data, representing commands and accessibility information. The devices display simplified, iconic representations of apps, and subtle digital particles flow between the conductor's wand and each device, signifying the MCP protocol. The background is a clean, modern stage with soft, focused lighting, hinting at a controlled and efficient environment. The repository name 'mobile-mcp' is subtly integrated into the conductor's podium. The style should be a vibrant 3D isometric illustration with clear visual metaphors and a clean, uncluttered composition.
